title: A more detailed farm-box wagon
items: The wagon collection has a reconstructed farm-box model with weathered boards, shaped wheel hubs, iron fittings and a separately articulated front axle and pole. Its modern source artist is credited; the wagon's historical maker and owner remain unknown.

Desktop railway rendering releases its uploaded geometry from page memory while keeping the same rail detail. A reset graphics context pauses rendering until retained resources can recover or the normal page reload completes.
